value.name: confirms Monday week meeting
value.description: She ends the call by confirming that they will meet on Monday week.

value.name: self-soothes after call
value.description: After hanging up, she steadies herself by pressing her hands to the desk and breathing deliberately, a coping habit from law school.
evidence: She hung up and put both hands flat on her desk and breathed in and out four times, which was a thing she had taught herself to do in law school during the trial advocacy class and which she had not had to do, in a professional context, for some time.

value.name: drafts meeting agenda
value.description: She spends the afternoon drafting a five-item agenda for the Monday week meeting about the Serrano matter.
evidence: The afternoon went on. She drafted an agenda for the Monday week meeting, which was a short document with five items, of which the first was "review of filed codicil and its operative effect," the second was "review of appraisal," the third was "discussion of options re: disposition of the residence," the fourth was "discussion of timeline and any extensions required," and the fifth was "next steps."

value.name: emails agenda to Marcus
value.description: She sends the agenda only to Marcus, preferring to distribute printed copies at the meeting instead of relying on email.
evidence: She emailed the agenda to Marcus and to no one else, because the practice she preferred was to bring the agenda to the meeting in printed form and distribute it there, so that the document had the weight of an artifact rather than the lightness of an email.

value.name: plans to refine agenda over weekend
value.description: She decides she will continue refining the agenda over the weekend.
evidence: She would, over the weekend, refine it.

value.name: attends partner meeting
value.description: At four o'clock she attends a partner's meeting on unrelated matters and participates competently but without distinction.
evidence: At four she went to the partner's meeting, which concerned an entirely different set of matters and which lasted forty minutes and which she contributed to competently and without distinction.

value.name: decides not to work late
value.description: At 5:15 she resolves not to stay late on Friday and not to work on the Serrano matter over the weekend except mentally.
evidence: At five-fifteen she came back to her office and stood at her desk and decided that she would not stay late on a Friday and she would not work over the weekend on the Serrano matter except to think about it, which was a form of work she could not avoid and would not try to.

value.name: leaves for home
value.description: She leaves the office to go home after making her decision about the weekend.
